_comment: Hand-picked wide-scene descriptions for story illustrations, keyed by story id. Generated separately from character portraits (which use Gemini via generate_character_art.py) -- this batch is generated on Google Colab's free-tier T4 GPU with an open-source model (SDXL), specifically to avoid further Gemini API spend. Not the full 324 stories yet -- this is a small first batch to validate that the open-source pipeline can actually match the established stylized-3D-animation look before committing to the rest.
story_creation: God's Spirit hovering over a vast cosmic void of swirling light and darkness, the very first moment of creation, stars and galaxies just beginning to form in the distance
story_the_flood: Noah's massive wooden ark floating on a vast flooded world under a breaking stormy sky, distant mountain peaks barely visible above the waterline, a single beam of light breaking through the clouds
story_feeding_the_5000: Jesus and his disciples distributing bread and fish among a vast seated crowd on a grassy hillside at golden hour, overflowing baskets of food being carried through the crowd
story_david_and_goliath: young David facing the massive armored Philistine giant Goliath across the battlefield of the valley of Elah, a sling raised in David's hand, both armies watching tensely from either side
story_crucifixion: three crosses silhouetted on a hill outside Jerusalem at dusk, a dramatic darkened stormy sky overhead, a small group of mourners gathered at a respectful distance below
story_lions_den: Daniel standing calm and unharmed among several lions in a torchlit stone den, soldiers and the king peering down anxiously from an opening high above
